# Definition — the 0

What the matheme **IS**. File 1 of the Binary Explication ([source house](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md)), projecting its own structure. Its sections spell the short chain: `§0/1 → §0 → §1 = 4+2 → §2 4+2 → §3 = 5→0 → §4 5→0 → §5 = 0/1 → §5→0`.

## Projected structure (the file's own headings)

- **[the-matheme](the-matheme.md)** — the opening question ("How is it that I am present to my experience?"); 0/1 earned from lived grammar ("I see x" → "I am aware of the seeing of x"); the Lacanian genealogy; the M1 address.
- **[minus-over-minus](minus-over-minus.md)** — `−/− = AND/OR / X/x`: the bare logic of differentiation, one mark made two by the slash.
- **[copula](copula.md)** — the graphical derivation of `=`, `/`, `≠`; `/ = ( = =/≠ ≠ )`; Ø/X; `(0/Ø)/(1/X)`.
- **[harmonics-and-recount](harmonics-and-recount.md)** — the count 4+2=6; the recount `4+2 → (3+1)+2`; the three harmonics (Being, Becoming, Knowing/unKnowing); the compact `( = /) : (=/≠ ()) : (≠ =)`.
- **[six-determinations](six-determinations.md)** — derived line-by-line through the poem: Ground `0/1`, Definition `?/!`, Dynamis `−/+`, Pattern `X/x`, Context `AM/IS`, Real-isation `∞/dx`, bracketed by the parent `−/−` and the return `1/0` — the eight.
- **[catuskoti-crossing](catuskoti-crossing.md)** — IS / IS-NOT / BOTH / NEITHER / **SILENCE**; "0 IS AND/OR IS-NOT EQUAL TO 1"; the fraction-reading of the vinculum.
- **[immutable-subject](immutable-subject.md)** — the witness-argument; 0, Ø, X, Ø/X, (0/Ø)/(1/X); the charitable cogito (line 47; indexed CT-16); *isoid*, the flagged coinage.

Pages are projected from the housed file per the register record form; the file's headings are the load-bearing names.
